title: erysimum pumilum var. oreites
intro: Erysimum pumilum var. oreites, commonly known as Dwarf Wallflower, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-anxiety, anti-spasmodic, and anti-convulsant properties, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Erysimum pumilum var. oreites include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
